questions.question_text:
A student calculates $480-545=-65$ mL for a submerged object.
What correction is needed?

options.why: Adds the readings instead of finding the rise.
Accepts an impossible negative volume caused by reversed subtraction.
Treats the incorrect difference as another water reading.

questions.solution_text:
**Identify the before-reading, after-reading or amount displaced.**
Before $480$ mL; after $545$ mL.

**Find or compare the change in the volume reading.**
$545-480=65\text{ mL}$.

**Record the result and check the measurement.**
Subtract after minus before; the object displaces $65$ mL.
